images.caption: I took these photos in August 2009 during a hike to Lost Lake. This is an excellent but long trail outside of Seward, Alaska. We did a traverse, starting on the north side and exiting from the south side. It was still about 15 miles long with a bit of a climb on the way in. The day started off rainy and gray but got a lot better as we kept climbing. One of the major benefits was all the ripe blueberries on the trail - and they were so sweet - just like me!

images.caption:
I took these photos on 8 March 2009 at the ceremonial start of the Iditarod sled dog race in Anchorage, Alaska. This was the 37th running of The Last Great Race. I get a thrill out of each race - the dogs were born to run and it is another thing that makes me proud to be an Alaskan!

Note: for the ceremonial run the mushers have paying passengers - I think they are called Iditariders - these people bid on a chance to go on the ceremonial run. The actual Iditarod starts from Willow, Alaska, on the day after the ceremonial start, minus the Iditariders.
